name: Roberto Rocca
notes: Roberto Rocca, longtime head of Argentina's Techint group and first chairman of Tenaris, died in Milan on 10 June 2003 aged 81 (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roberto_Rocca). The group is now led by his son Paolo Rocca.

name: Carl Ray Pohlad
notes: Carl Pohlad, Minnesota financier and Minnesota Twins owner from 1984, died 5 January 2009 aged 93 (source: https://www.mprnews.org/story/2009/01/05/pohlad1). The family business continues as Pohlad Companies.

name: Andreas E.Rihs
notes: Andy Rihs, co-founder and longtime CEO/chairman of Phonak/Sonova and backer of the BMC cycling team, died 18 April 2018 aged 75 (source: https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/cycling-supporter_swiss-entrepreneur-and-bmc-cycling-backer-andy-rihs-has-died/44058924).
